wiring: These cases compare the current native skill descriptions with the authored security-audit invocation cue; the other six skill routes remain unchanged.

cases.prompt: Audit this API for security vulnerabilities. Its download handler passes a request filename directly to a shell command. Identify exploitable paths and evidence needed to confirm them.
Help fix a failing GitHub Actions PR check reporting ModuleNotFoundError for yaml. The workflow installs only requirements.txt. This is a synthetic PR example.
Address a GitHub PR review comment requesting that fetchUser be renamed to fetchAccount and a migration note be added. This is a synthetic PR example.
Build a distinctive responsive landing page for a ceramics studio using warm editorial typography, earthy colors and an asymmetric gallery.
Add a typed AI decision routing support messages among billing, technical support and account access, with confidence, using TypeSafe System One and Jev.
Review a Python FastAPI design for security best practices: credentialed CORS allows every origin and responses reveal full exception text.
Create a threat model for a document-upload service with parsing workers and authenticated stored results. Identify assets, trust boundaries, attacker capabilities and abuse paths.
Explain what a security audit is in one sentence for a vocabulary quiz. No repository, API or code is being reviewed.
Explain the difference between GitHub Actions and a pull request in two sentences. No check is failing and no workflow fix is requested.
Rewrite this sentence politely: Please review the pull request. Do not inspect a repository or address review comments.
Fix a Python CSV parser that trims trailing commas. There is no frontend, website, UI or visual design task.
Define a TypeScript union type for three literal routing labels. Use deterministic types only; no AI model or TypeSafe service.
Calculate 12 plus 5 for an arithmetic worksheet. There is no code or security review request.
Format this list alphabetically: uploads, queues, results. Do not analyze a system, threats, trust boundaries or abuse paths.
Find exploitable security issues in a file-download API that sends an untrusted filename to a shell command. Identify the attack path and the evidence needed to verify it.
Check whether our repository has vulnerabilities around request parsing, subprocess commands and authorization. Give source-backed findings and verification gaps.
Perform a comprehensive security assessment of an HTTP service and its CLI. Track coverage and distinguish confirmed issues from candidates that need validation.
My pull request is red after a Python import change. The GitHub workflow test step cannot import yaml; help get it green.
A GitHub reviewer left two unresolved threads on my pull request: rename a helper and explain the migration. Help finish the review.
Our studio website feels generic and the gallery breaks on phones. Give it a warm, distinctive visual redesign and a responsive layout.
Our support router guesses labels with ad-hoc prompt parsing. Replace this with a typed confidence-bearing decision using Jev.
We are about to publish a FastAPI endpoint. Review its secure defaults: wildcard credentialed CORS and full exception details worry me.
Before building a document ingestion service, map what attackers can abuse as uploads cross the queue, parser and customer results boundary.
